description: Synthetic ONVIF probe failure wording matrix. It fixes sanitized operator-facing summaries and is not a product API contract.

scenarios.inputSummary: Probe request uses a non-http endpoint.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at request: endpoint must be http(s)

scenarios.inputSummary: Probe request has a non-positive timeout.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at request: timeout must be positive

scenarios.inputSummary: Probe adapter is called without a SOAP transport.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at request: transport is required

scenarios.inputSummary: GetServices transport returns HTTP 401 with sensitive diagnostic text.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at GetServices: HTTP 401

scenarios.inputSummary: GetServices transport fails without HTTP status and includes sensitive diagnostic text.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at GetServices: transport error

scenarios.inputSummary: GetServices succeeds but does not advertise Media or Media2.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at GetServices: Media or Media2 service is required
requiredTerms: Media or Media2 service is required

scenarios.inputSummary: Media2 profile is discovered but no RTSP stream URI is accepted.

expected.error: ONVIF probe failed at GetStreamUri: no live RTSP profile discovered
